items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A collapsible panel: a pointer clicks the header, the chevron turns and the content unfolds, then it closes again.

items.name: accordion-unfold
items.title: Accordion Unfold
items.description: A tight paper zigzag unfolds sideways into a flat card with the logo printed across it. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host prints its own logo by replacing the .au-print contents in the script.

items.name: agent-run
items.title: Agent Run
items.description: A brand-neutral AI agent run that thinks, calls tools against a real-seconds timer and streams a markdown answer in bursts.

items.name: agent-terminal
items.title: Agent Terminal
items.description: An unbranded coding-agent terminal: the window or launcher eases in, panels fade up and a task types itself into the prompt with a blinking caret.

items.name: ai-prompt-composer
items.title: AI Prompt Composer
items.description: An unbranded AI chat composer: the greeting and input ease in, a prompt types itself and the voice button morphs into the send button while the suggestion chips fade.

items.name: ai-prompt-flow
items.title: AI Prompt Flow
items.description: A full prompt-to-answer scene: the prompt types itself, the button runs to loading, a skeleton shimmers, the answer crossfades in and a toast confirms.

items.name: ai-text-loading
items.title: AI Text Loading
items.description: A cycling status word whose letters blur in one by one while a soft brightness wave runs through them: the look of an AI that is working.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A destructive confirmation: a pointer clicks Delete account, a dimmed alert dialog scales in and the Delete button is pressed.

items.name: anamorphic-flare
items.title: Anamorphic Flare
items.description: A point of light stretches into a cinematic horizontal streak that sweeps the frame and reveals the logo behind it. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host swaps in its own logo by editing the .af-logo element.

items.name: animated-bar-chart
items.title: Animated Bar Chart
items.description: Bars spring up from the baseline with a staggered cascade.

items.name: animated-gradient-text
items.title: Animated Gradient Text
items.description: Text filled with a wide three-colour gradient that drifts slowly from one end to the other and back, so the colours flow through the letters.

items.name: animated-line-chart
items.title: Animated Line Chart
items.description: A line chart whose path draws on from left to right with a glowing leading dot.

items.name: ascii-dissolve
items.title: ASCII Dissolve
items.description: The frame turns into plain text: a field of monospace characters rises over the outgoing scene, flows as living ASCII, then dissolves cell by cell into the incoming scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .asd-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: ascii-render
items.title: ASCII Render
items.description: A scene redrawn as text, one character per cell chosen by the cell's brightness, in green ink or in the scene's own colours. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a stat and a bar chart; label, number and bars from variables), not over the host video.

items.name: aurora-text
items.title: Aurora Text
items.description: Four-colour gradient text whose colours drift slowly through the letters, magenta to violet to blue to cyan by default, set after a plain lead-in word.

items.name: backdrop
items.title: Backdrop
items.description: Full-frame colour or gradient fill with a padded, rounded, shadowed content frame (the floating-card look). Frame holds a built-in placeholder.

items.name: bauhaus-build
items.title: Bauhaus Build
items.description: Geometric Bauhaus pieces tumble in, snap into a composition, then tumble away again.

items.name: blueprint
items.title: Blueprint
items.description: A product wipes left to right into a technical drawing with a blueprint grid, white linework, dimension lines and a red callout. A built-in red device stands in for the product; labels and colors are variables.

items.name: blur-in
items.title: Blur In
items.description: A single element is revealed with blur, opacity and a directional offset, settling in place: a premium entrance for a card, image or composed scene.

items.name: blur-out-up
items.title: Blur Out Up
items.description: Words arrive clean and depart upward with increasing blur for airy exits.

items.name: blur-reveal
items.title: Blur Reveal
items.description: A transition: the outgoing scene softens away while the incoming one resolves out of blur, with a faint scale drift.

items.name: bottom-up-letters
items.title: Bottom-Up Letters
items.description: Letters rise from below in a pronounced staircase, one symbol at a time.

items.name: brand-guidelines
items.title: Brand Guidelines
items.description: A complete editorial identity film: a geometric brand mark, a terracotta, graphite, stone and paper palette, a type specimen that types and deletes itself through eight styles, a layered collage of drawn object plates, and three flipping tiles that become the closing wordmark. Silent: sound is added by the host. The object photos are drawn with SVG by default; pass image paths to use real photographs.

items.name: breathing-text
items.title: Breathing Text
items.description: Letters flex between two variable-font settings (weight and slant) in a staggered, mirrored loop, so the word appears to breathe.

items.name: brick-mosaic
items.title: Brick Mosaic
items.description: Toy bricks drop in row by row from the bottom with a small bounce and build a pixel-art image on a baseplate. Give it a pixel-art grid as text in the pattern variable, or leave it empty for a built-in red disc.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button that plays its whole lifecycle: a pointer arrives, the button hovers, presses, shows a spinner, then a check.

items.name: camera-lens
items.title: Camera Lens
items.description: A scene seen through a lens instead of rendered flat: softness growing toward the corners, bright text blooming, red and blue fringing at the edges, a gentle barrel bend and a falloff in the light. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a render queue list; title, rows and background from variables), not over the host video. Subtle enough to leave running under a whole shot.

items.name: caption-active-pop
items.title: Caption Active Pop
items.description: The word being spoken turns to the accent color and springs up in scale, then settles back as the voice moves on.

items.name: caption-blur-in
items.title: Caption Blur In
items.description: Each word resolves out of a soft blur the moment it is spoken, for captions that arrive quietly.

items.name: caption-bounce-in
items.title: Caption Bounce In
items.description: Each word springs up into place with a little overshoot the moment it is spoken, and the phrase builds word by word.

items.name: caption-cube
items.title: Caption Cube
items.description: Each new phrase turns into view as the next face of a 3D cube, the previous phrase rotating up and away on a horizontal hinge.

items.name: caption-dim-progress
items.title: Caption Dim Progress
items.description: The whole phrase sits on screen dimmed and each word brightens the moment it is spoken, with no motion at all.

items.name: caption-drop
items.title: Caption Drop
items.description: Each word falls into place from above and bounces as it lands the moment it is spoken, and the whole phrase drops out of frame when the speaker pauses.

items.name: caption-emoji
items.title: Caption Emoji
items.description: An emoji pops up above a chosen word the moment it is spoken and stays until the phrase leaves.

items.name: caption-emoji-beat
items.title: Caption Emoji Beat
items.description: Emoji stamps land on the beat over a caption line: each arrives with overshoot, wobbles once, holds, then releases.

items.name: caption-handwrite
items.title: Caption Handwrite
items.description: Each word is inked in by hand from left to right at the pace it is spoken, every word sitting at its own slight angle.

items.name: caption-highlight-box
items.title: Caption Highlight Box
items.description: A solid box travels behind the word being spoken, sliding from word to word as the voice moves on.

items.name: caption-karaoke
items.title: Caption Karaoke
items.description: Each word fills with color left to right exactly as it is spoken, with the whole phrase readable before the voice reaches it.

items.name: caption-knockout
items.title: Caption Knockout
items.description: A solid plate with the words cut clean through it, each word punching out the moment it is spoken so the footage shows through the letters.

items.name: caption-label-maker
items.title: Caption Label Maker
items.description: Each phrase is punched letter by letter into a strip of embossing tape at the pace it is spoken, the tape feeding out as the words arrive.

items.name: caption-marker
items.title: Caption Marker
items.description: Plain captions where the words that matter get a highlighter swipe the moment they are spoken.

items.name: caption-outline
items.title: Caption Outline
items.description: Heavy-stroked captions that stay readable over any footage, with the spoken word switching to a contrast color and nothing else moving.

items.name: caption-prosody
items.title: Caption Prosody
items.description: Word size follows the delivery: drawn-out words land large and rushed words stay small, so the rhythm of the voice is visible with the sound off.

items.name: caption-redact
items.title: Caption Redact
items.description: The whole phrase starts blacked out like a declassified file, and each bar pulls away the moment its word is spoken.

items.name: caption-rise
items.title: Caption Rise
items.description: Each word slides up out of a mask at its baseline the moment it is spoken, with no bounce and no scale.

items.name: caption-scramble
items.title: Caption Scramble
items.description: Each word arrives as random glyphs at the moment it is spoken and decodes left to right into the real letters.

items.name: caption-slice
items.title: Caption Slice
items.description: Each word arrives cut in two, the top half sliding in from the left and the bottom from the right, locking together the moment it is spoken.

items.name: caption-slot
items.title: Caption Slot
items.description: One short line at a time, each new phrase rolling up into place as the previous one rolls out the top.

items.name: caption-speaker
items.title: Caption Speaker
items.description: Dialogue captions where every phrase takes its speaker's color, so a conversation reads like a script.

items.name: caption-split-flap
items.title: Caption Split Flap
items.description: Every letter sits on its own flap tile and clatters through a few characters before landing the moment the word is spoken, like a station departure board.

items.name: caption-stack
items.title: Caption Stack
items.description: Kinetic captions stacked a couple of words per line, with the keyword of each page set large on its own line.

items.name: caption-stamp
items.title: Caption Stamp
items.description: Plain captions where the words that matter slam down as a rubber stamp the moment they are spoken.

items.name: caption-subtitle
items.title: Caption Subtitle
items.description: Classic broadcast subtitles: a whole phrase on a translucent plate, with no word-level animation at all.

items.name: caption-teleprompter
items.title: Caption Teleprompter
items.description: The whole transcript scrolls smoothly through a short window with the current line centred, past lines fading above and the next line waiting below.

items.name: caption-timeline
items.title: Caption Timeline
items.description: The whole transcript laid out on a scrolling time strip that slides under a fixed playhead, so every pause shows up as space between words.

items.name: caption-typewriter
items.title: Caption Typewriter
items.description: Each word types out character by character at the pace it is spoken, with a caret that blinks while the speaker pauses.

items.name: caption-underline
items.title: Caption Underline
items.description: A bar slides under the word being spoken, travelling from word to word while the text itself stays untouched.

items.name: caption-weight
items.title: Caption Weight
items.description: The word being spoken swells from a light weight to a heavy one and relaxes as the voice moves on, with no layout shift.

items.name: caption-word-pop
items.title: Caption Word Pop
items.description: One large word at a time, each popping in on a spring the moment it is spoken.

items.name: caret
items.title: Caret
items.description: A blinking text caret: a thin rounded bar that flips on and off, sitting after a line of text.

items.name: caret-swap
items.title: Caret Swap
items.description: A gradient caret expands into a block that consumes the first text, then types the second.

items.name: caret-wipe
items.title: Caret Wipe
items.description: A tall text caret sweeps across the frame: behind it the new scene is typed in, ahead of it the old scene is backspaced away. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .crw-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: centered-word-build
items.title: Centered Word Build
items.description: Words appear sharply from below while the centered phrase pushes closer on every beat.

items.name: chat-flow
items.title: Chat Flow
items.description: A messaging conversation: outgoing messages type into the composer and send, typing dots precede replies, and reactions pop onto bubbles.

items.name: chat-review-typed
items.title: Chat Review Typed
items.description: A headline with the shop name on its own line, a customer's avatar and name, an incoming bubble with typing dots that then writes the review letter by letter, a dark reply bubble sliding in from the right, five stars with a score line, and a call-to-action pill. White page, hairline bubbles.

items.name: chat-to-preview-layout
items.title: Chat to Preview Layout
items.description: A two-up split where the chat panel shrinks and the preview panel expands, to show an agent building something. Both panels hold generic placeholder content. On a tall frame the split stacks vertically (chat on top).

items.name: check-list
items.title: Check List
items.description: A handwritten checklist that writes itself out, then ticks and strikes through every done item.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox that a pointer ticks and unticks: the box fills with the primary color and the check draws in.

items.name: checkout-flow
items.title: Checkout Flow
items.description: A cursor-driven checkout card: pick the yearly plan, type a card number, accept the terms, pay, and a toast confirms.

items.name: chromatic-wave
items.title: Chromatic Wave
items.description: A soft wave travels down through the type; where it crosses, the letters ripple and split into RGB fringes, then settle back to white.

items.name: circular-text
items.title: Circular Text
items.description: Characters sit evenly around a circle and the whole ring spins steadily, like a badge or a stamp.

items.name: cloth-reveal
items.title: Cloth Reveal
items.description: A satin sheet draped over your content is yanked from one corner, folding and fluttering as a simulated cloth before it clears the frame. The Verlet simulation runs once at load with a fixed timestep and a seeded rest shape (a 32×20 grid), every frame's points are stored, and the timeline only draws the stored frame. The content under the sheet is a neutral lockup with editable text.

items.name: code-morph
items.title: Code Morph
items.description: A code panel morphs between versions of a file: surviving tokens glide to their new line and column, removed code blurs out and new code fades in. The clip is 4.6 s long for the default two versions and 36-frame morph.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable select: the panel opens, a query types itself, the list narrows, and the matching row is picked.

items.name: comic-panels
items.title: Comic Panels
items.description: The frame cracks into a three-panel comic page with speed lines and halftone, then the action panel bursts into a full-frame word such as POW. A built-in lockup stands in for the hero; a host replaces the contents of the .cp-hero layer with its own logo or headline.

items.name: comic-text
items.title: Comic Text
items.description: Comic-book lettering: skewed uppercase letters with a halftone-dot fill, a heavy black outline and a stacked hard shadow, popping in with a small overshoot.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: A keyboard-driven command palette: the backdrop dims, a query types itself, the list filters, and the first row is picked.

items.name: command-menu-item
items.title: Command Menu Item
items.description: One command palette row going idle, hover, press and selected as the cursor reaches it and clicks.

items.name: confetti
items.title: Confetti
items.description: A deterministic burst of confetti pieces that fall, spin and flutter with gravity.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click menu that opens at the cursor over a file card, then an item is hovered, pressed and the menu closes.

items.name: cradle-text
items.title: Cradle Text
items.description: Letters hang from a rail like a Newton's cradle: the first is pulled out and released, the knock runs through the row and the last letter swings out.

items.name: crt-screen
items.title: CRT Screen
items.description: A scene behind curved tube glass: barrel distortion, an RGB phosphor mask, scanlines that bow with the picture, bloom around bright text and corners that run off into black. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a render queue list; title, rows and background from variables), not over the host video. The only motion is a 1 % brightness breath, so it holds as a look.

items.name: crumple-toss
items.title: Crumple Toss
items.description: A card crumples into a paper wad in stop-motion poses and is tossed into a bin: the old way, thrown away.

items.name: cursor
items.title: Cursor
items.description: An animated mouse pointer that follows a scripted path to a button, clicks it with a ripple, and the button shows hover, press, loading and success.

items.name: cursor-gravity
items.title: Cursor Gravity
items.description: A rounded triangular cursor tugs a button out of the screen edge with pulsed elastic resistance.

items.name: dia-text-reveal
items.title: Dia Text Reveal
items.description: A soft multi-colour gradient band sweeps left to right across the text, revealing the letters behind it; with several texts it then swaps to the next and sweeps again.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog: a pointer clicks a trigger, the scrim dims the frame and the dialog scales in; clicking Save closes it.

items.name: displacement
items.title: Displacement
items.description: The frame shears into a grid of tiles that slide out of register with red/blue fringing and film grain, swap to the next scene mid-slide, then settle back. Runs its WebGL shader over two built-in panels (a stat and a bar chart, then a render queue; text and colours from variables), not over the host's scenes: 45 frames of the first panel, a 18-frame transition, then the second panel. To use it between your own scenes, copy the shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: dither-dissolve
items.title: Dither Dissolve
items.description: A two-color ordered-dither pattern rises over the outgoing scene, holds, and falls away to reveal the next one. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D Bayer dither instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .dtd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: dock-text
items.title: Dock Text
items.description: A pointer glides across a line of capitals and the letters near it stretch tall like a dock, the nearest one most, easing back to size when the pointer leaves.

items.name: dolly-zoom
items.title: Dolly Zoom
items.description: The vertigo shot: a corridor with a red door stretches deeper while the subject in the middle keeps its exact size. A host puts its own subject in by replacing the .dz-subject svg with its own centered content.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A bottom panel: a pointer clicks a trigger inside a mock app window, the scrim dims it and a drawer rises from the bottom; clicking Save closes it.

items.name: drift
items.title: Drift
items.description: A slow constant camera push-in, so no scene is ever frozen. Plays on a built-in placeholder scene.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: An action menu: a pointer clicks the trigger, the menu drops open, a row is hovered and pressed, then the menu closes.

items.name: dropdown-menu-item
items.title: Dropdown Menu Item
items.description: A menu row: a pointer hovers it and presses it, inside a small action menu.

items.name: duotone-beat
items.title: Duotone Beat
items.description: A two-ink halftone portrait that swaps its ink pair on every beat, punches in on the downbeat and shows a bar indicator. A built-in silhouette stands in for the photo; a host replaces the contents of the .db-picture layer with its own image.

items.name: dynamic-text
items.title: Dynamic Text
items.description: Word-to-word morph where letters are physical: shared letters glide to their new spot on a spring arc, others fall away, new ones drop in and land with a squash.

items.name: echo-stack
items.title: Echo Stack
items.description: A word focuses in at the center while outline copies of it unfold above and below and keep drifting, like the one clear line on a spinning drum.

items.name: ecosystem-constellation
items.title: Ecosystem Constellation
items.description: A central product mark orbited by integration satellites with pulsing data lines. The eight satellites are generic placeholder marks, not real brands.

items.name: ember-burn
items.title: Ember Burn
items.description: The outgoing frame is set on fire: a noisy burn front eats the bright parts first, the edge boils and glows, charred rims fall away and sparks drift off carrying the frame's colour, uncovering the next scene. Runs its WebGL shader over two built-in panels (a stat and a bar chart, then a render queue; text and colours from variables), not over the host's scenes: 60 frames of the first panel, a 40-frame transition, then the second panel. To use it between your own scenes, copy the shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: event-countdown-clock
items.title: Event Countdown Clock
items.description: A T− clock in four cells (days, hours, minutes, seconds) in a hairline panel under a title that wipes in. The days and hours race down, the last five seconds tick in real time with a ten-segment bar emptying each second, then the clock turns to the accent colour, flips to T+, and a short "now" line takes the title's place.

items.name: exploded-view
items.title: Exploded View
items.description: An isometric stack of slabs springs apart with leader lines and labels, holds, then clicks back together.

items.name: extrude-pop
items.title: Extrude Pop
items.description: A flat word pops up out of the plane on a solid colored 3D body, no camera involved.

items.name: fade-through
items.title: Fade Through
items.description: One text fades out and a second fades in with a slight rise, scale and blur, so scenes change calmly.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A labelled form field: a label above, an input that focuses and types, helper text below, and a second filled field in the same group.

items.name: flash-sale-burst
items.title: Flash Sale Burst
items.description: A two-word headline rises in, a big percent figure bursts in and shakes once in the accent colour, two crossed running ribbons (black, and outlined) run their text in opposite directions and clear away, then the deadline is set in a bordered box. Clean white page, no starburst.

items.name: flow-field
items.title: Flow Field
items.description: Hundreds of particles ride a seeded, slowly changing vector field and leave fine fading trails, as a seamless loop.

items.name: focus-blur-resolve
items.title: Focus Blur Resolve
items.description: Text starts blurred and resolves to crisp, holds, then drifts up and blurs out.

items.name: focus-pull
items.title: Focus Pull
items.description: A rack focus between scenes: the outgoing scene defocuses and brightens, the incoming scene pulls into sharp focus. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .fcp-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: fog-rise
items.title: Fog Rise
items.description: Display text resolves out of fog center-out, sharpening from heavy blur as it tilts up on a spring.

items.name: followers-overview
items.title: Followers Overview
items.description: Follow notifications flip through in 3D, one name at a time, then the total follower count blurs in with a spring pop, the account handle and a confetti burst.

items.name: fomo-limit-orders
items.title: Order Flow
items.description: An 18.5-second trading-interface demo with fictional data, graphite surfaces and amber controls: three opening lines over drifting bars, a phone with a position card that the camera pushes into and orbits, a limit-order ticket whose slider contracts into a price field, a confirmation card, and the closing wordmark. Silent: sound is added by the host. All figures are illustrative.

items.name: font-weight-text
items.title: Font Weight Text
items.description: Letters breathe through a variable font weight, thin to heavy and back, each on its own phase so a wave of weight rolls along the word from the middle outward.

items.name: glass-code-block
items.title: Glass Code Block
items.description: A frosted-glass code editor window with a small regex colouring (plain spans, no highlighter library) and a line-by-line stagger reveal. Transparent, so it composites over any background.

items.name: glass-code-walk
items.title: Glass Code Walk
items.description: A camera that scans a frosted-glass code block top to bottom as its lines appear, then pulls back to a centred hold.

items.name: glitch-cut
items.title: Glitch Cut
items.description: A hard cut torn into displaced horizontal slices with red/blue channel split and corrupted blocks that leak the other scene; each band hands over at its own moment. Runs its WebGL shader over two built-in panels (a stat and a bar chart, then a render queue; text and colours from variables), not over the host's scenes: 45 frames of the first panel, a 12-frame transition, then the second panel. To use it between your own scenes, copy the shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: glyph-anatomy
items.title: Glyph Anatomy
items.description: A word builds as in a font editor, with metric guides, anchors along each contour and Bézier handles that pull straight segments into curves before the glyphs fill.

items.name: goal-ring-card
items.title: Goal Ring Card
items.description: A day-summary card: a ring fills to the share of a daily goal while the figure inside counts up, above a bar that restates the goal.

items.name: gooey-morph
items.title: Gooey Morph
items.description: Bars fly in Tetris-style, land as a row, then melt into a word through a gooey blur-and-threshold morph.

items.name: gradient-scale-cut-text
items.title: Gradient Scale Cut Text
items.description: An oversized gradient reveal snaps to a compact blurred line that settles into focus.

items.name: gradual-spacing-text
items.title: Gradual Spacing Text
items.description: Letters drift in from the left and fade up one after another, so the line seems to space itself out gradually as it appears.

items.name: grain-dissolve
items.title: Grain Dissolve
items.description: A grainy gradient field blurs the outgoing scene away, fills the frame, and then clears to reveal the incoming scene. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D gradient instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .grd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: gravity-pile
items.title: Gravity Pile
items.description: Seeded circles, squares and triangles rain down, bounce off the floor and each other, and settle into a heap, with optional words or emoji of your own landing on top.

items.name: grid-wave
items.title: Grid Wave
items.description: A wave crosses the frame (outward from the centre, or left, right, up or down) and lifts the picture into a grid of solid tiles with a gap between them, tinted and shaded as they rise, then sets them down carrying the next scene. Runs its WebGL shader over two built-in panels (a stat and a bar chart, then a render queue; text and colours from variables), not over the host's scenes: 60 frames of the first panel, a 36-frame transition, then the second panel. To use it between your own scenes, copy the shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: halftone-print
items.title: Halftone Print
items.description: A scene printed instead of displayed: cyan, magenta and yellow dot screens at their own angles on warm paper, each plate a touch out of register. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a paper poster; kicker, headline and paragraph from variables), not over the host video. Best on light, graphic scenes with real midtones.

items.name: hand-count
items.title: Hand Count
items.description: A number that counts up in stop-motion poses, rewritten by hand at every pose.

items.name: handwrite
items.title: Handwrite
items.description: Handwritten text laid down letter by letter on a quantized stop-motion clock.

items.name: handwriting-text
items.title: Handwriting Text
items.description: Writes a string on, character by character, with a pen nib riding the wet edge of the ink and a slight hand-made tilt on every letter.

items.name: highlighter
items.title: Highlighter
items.description: A hand-drawn mark is scribbled over part of a sentence: marker highlight, underline, box, circle, strike-through, crossed-off or bracket, drawn stroke by stroke with a slightly wobbly line.

items.name: hologram
items.title: Hologram
items.description: A scene played as projected light: a ghost double shimmers off the image, emission lines structure it, a halo spills from bright areas, and everything leans toward its tint. WebGL.

items.name: hyperspace
items.title: Hyperspace
items.description: A jump to lightspeed: stars stretch into streaks around the outgoing scene, which is pushed toward the camera, then a white flash cuts to the incoming scene while the last streaks fade. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .hsp-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
